overview: SoftAura Skin Care M1 Speed Demo delivers a Flutter 3.x Android-first mobile app that browses a locally embedded mock catalog of 24 skincare SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care (curated third-party brands in the Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ~$12.99 / 1299 cents USD style), shows product detail with name, price, category, description, and rounded imagery, and supports an optional in-memory cart that clears on process restart. No backend, auth, payments, or checkout ship in M1—the app must launch on an Android emulator with mock data immediately. SoftAura visual tokens are fixed for implementation without approval gates: primary accent #7A9E8E (sage), warm ivory backgrounds, charcoal text, rounded product imagery. This document freezes the production-ready target architecture (NestJS + PostgreSQL 16 + Stripe) and a minimal OpenAPI 3.1 contract (health plus two catalog reads) so later milestones implement against an exact API and data model without guessing. Prices are integer USD cents with ISO 4217 currency; stock is per variant.

components.name: Flutter Mobile App (M1 primary)
components.responsibility: Renders product list (browse), product detail, and optional in-memory cart. Embeds seeded SoftAura mock catalog of 24 SKUs for M1. Handles loading, empty, and error states; category association visible on list cards. SoftAura theme from design tokens (sage #7A9E8E, warm ivory, charcoal). Preserves list scroll/context when navigating back from detail. Post-M1 switches to generated OpenAPI client (dart-dio) against NestJS.
components.technology: Flutter 3.x, Dart, Riverpod (Notifier/AsyncNotifier), go_router, freezed/json_serializable, flutter_secure_storage (M2+), flutter_test, integration_test

components.name: Local Mock Catalog (M1)
components.responsibility: Provides exactly 24 skincare SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care with name, brand, category, priceCents, currency USD, rounded image asset, description, and default-variant stock. Must include an Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing at 1299 cents USD. Source of truth for M1 browse/detail/cart; shapes mirror OpenAPI ProductSummary/ProductDetail for an easy M2 swap.
components.technology: assets/data/catalog.json, bundled image assets, Dart freezed models

components.name: NestJS API Server (M2+)
components.responsibility: Contract-first REST API under global prefix /api/v1. Thin controllers, service-layer logic, PrismaService for data access. Catalog read endpoints first; auth, cart, orders, payments modules added after M1. DTOs use class-validator; responses match OpenAPI exactly.

components.name: PostgreSQL Database (M2+)
components.responsibility: System of record for users, catalog, carts, orders, and payment metadata. ACID transactions for stock reservation at checkout and order creation.

components.name: Stripe (later release)
components.responsibility: PaymentIntents in test mode; server creates intent, app confirms via Stripe SDK, webhook marks order paid. Card data never touches SoftAura servers.
components.technology: Stripe API, Stripe Flutter SDK, webhook signing secret

components.name: Docker / CI (M2+)
components.responsibility: docker-compose for local/staging (API + Postgres). GitHub Actions runs lint, unit, and e2e tests on PR.

backend_modules.name: health
backend_modules.responsibility: Liveness and database connectivity probe. Included in M1 OpenAPI contract; NestJS implementation deferred until backend work starts (does not block Flutter M1). Does not count toward the four API-operation cap.

backend_modules.name: catalog
backend_modules.responsibility: Public read-only SoftAura skincare catalog for browse and detail. Supports pagination, text search, and category filter (Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, Face Care). Product detail includes brand, description, category, and variants with per-variant price and stock. M1 Flutter uses local mock shaped like these responses; NestJS implements these two operations first in M2.

backend_modules.name: auth (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Email/password registration and login, JWT access (15 min) and refresh tokens, account deletion. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: users (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Profile and saved shipping addresses for checkout. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: cart (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Signed-in user cart persisted server-side. M1 uses in-memory CartNotifier only; guest carts out of scope until a later release that explicitly requires guest checkout. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: orders (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Order placement and history with status lifecycle pending_payment → paid → fulfilled → delivered, plus cancelled and refunded. Order lines snapshot product name and unit price. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: payments (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Stripe PaymentIntents and webhooks; card data never on server. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

app_features.name: catalog
screens: ProductListScreen (/products) — scrollable SoftAura product cards with name, formatted price from integer cents + USD (e.g. Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style as $12.99 from 1299 cents), rounded product imagery, category membership (Body Wash | Cleansers | Moisturizers | Face Care); warm ivory background, sage #7A9E8E accent, charcoal text; loading, empty, and error/retry states; all 24 seeded SKUs reachable by scroll

ProductDetailScreen (/products/:id) — name, brand, category, unit price (cents + USD), description, rounded product image; SoftAura styling; optional Add to cart (≥48dp); Android back returns to list with catalog still visible
app_features.state_management: CatalogRepository (M1: LocalCatalogDataSource from assets/data/catalog.json; M2+: generated CatalogApi). ProductListNotifier (AsyncNotifier) holds AsyncValue of the 24 products. ProductDetailNotifier loads one product by id. Price formatting helpers convert cents → display string without floats.

app_features.name: cart
screens: CartScreen (/cart) — optional M1; line items with product name and unit price snapshot (cents + currency) copied at add time; session-only until process kill
app_features.state_management: CartNotifier (Notifier<CartState>) session-only in-memory for M1; clears on full process restart. Add from ProductDetailScreen. No persistence, auth, payment, or backend sync in M1.

app_features.name: core
app_features.state_management: Design tokens in lib/core/theme: primary #7A9E8E, warm ivory background, charcoal text, rounded imagery radii—chosen without style-approval gates; go_router routes /products, /products/:id, /cart; no live HTTP in M1 debug builds (offline mock). Debug Android cleartext only for 10.0.2.2 when backend arrives.

data_model_notes: All monetary amounts are Int minor units (cents) with ISO 4217 currency code USD; never floats. Product is the merchandising parent (skincare listing with brand and category); ProductVariant is the purchasable SKU with its own priceCents, currency, and stockQuantity (and reservedQuantity for M2+ checkout holds). Listing cards show display price from the default or lowest active variant. Category is one of Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, Face Care (seeded as four Category rows; M1 mock associates each of 24 SKUs to exactly one). Flagship seed: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing at 1299 cents USD displayed as $12.99. CartItem and OrderItem snapshot productName and unitPriceCents at write time so later catalog edits do not alter past carts/orders. Order.status: pending_payment → paid → fulfilled → delivered, plus cancelled and refunded. Stock reservation at checkout (M2+); failed or expired payment releases reserved stock. User.passwordHash uses bcrypt or argon2; support account deletion with PII removal/anonymization. M1 runtime uses only embedded mock catalog JSON—no Prisma/Postgres connection.
security: M1 ships no auth, no mandatory network calls, and no PII, passwords, or payment data—mock catalog is read-only embedded data; do not send catalog or cart data to external payment providers in this increment.
M2+ JWT bearer auth: access tokens 15-minute TTL, refresh tokens rotated and stored hashed server-side; flutter_secure_storage on mobile.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (cost ≥12) or argon2id; never store plaintext.
All API input validated via class-validator DTOs; responses match OpenAPI schemas exactly; errors return { statusCode, error, message }.
Stripe webhook verifies Stripe-Signature; idempotent event handling; card PAN/CVC never touch SoftAura servers.
HTTPS-only in release mobile builds; debug Android allows cleartext to 10.0.2.2 only via network_security_config.
Config and secrets via environment variables validated at NestJS startup (@nestjs/config)—never committed.
Minimum personal data collection; account deletion removes or anonymizes PII.
Catalog and health endpoints are public (security: []); bearerAuth scheme is declared for future protected modules.

adrs.title: Local embedded mock catalog for SoftAura M1 Speed Demo
adrs.context: PRD requires the smallest runnable Flutter MVP on an Android emulator immediately with 24 skincare SKUs across four categories. NestJS, Postgres, generated clients, and CI would delay the demo. US-001/US-002/US-003 need browse, detail, and optional session cart only—no auth, payments, or checkout. Backend work is explicitly deferred if it slows delivery.
adrs.decision: M1 loads 24 SoftAura Skin Care SKUs from assets (catalog.json + rounded image assets), including an Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing at 1299 cents USD. Category membership and price formatting run in-process. No HTTP client is required in M1 builds. CatalogRepository abstracts the data source so M2 can swap to the generated OpenAPI client without rewriting screens.
adrs.consequences: Positive—offline demo, zero backend dependency, fastest path to validating SoftAura browse/detail UX. Negative—cart is session-only; no shared stock truth; M2 must migrate to API and keep server as source of truth for catalog and inventory.

adrs.title: Integer minor units for all money fields
adrs.context: Floating-point money causes rounding errors in totals and Stripe amounts. Project rules forbid floats for prices. Demo must show $12.99 from 1299 cents exactly for the body-wash style flagship listing.
adrs.decision: Store and transmit all prices as integer cents with currency code USD (ISO 4217). Flutter, NestJS, Prisma Int, and OpenAPI integer schemas agree. Formatting to display strings (e.g. $12.99) happens only in the presentation layer; flutter_test covers cents → display.
adrs.consequences: Positive—exact arithmetic, Stripe-compatible amounts, consistent contract. Negative—UI must use format helpers; developers must never use double for money.

adrs.title: Contract-first OpenAPI 3.1 capped to M1 catalog operations
adrs.context: Mobile convention requires a dart-dio client generated from OpenAPI. Hard scope limits this run to at most four API operations. Cart is in-memory and needs no API. Auth, payments, and checkout are out of scope. M1 prefers zero live business API dependency.
adrs.decision: Freeze OpenAPI 3.1 with GET /health (infra, uncapped), GET /products (search, category filter, pagination), and GET /products/{productId}. Bearer auth is declared for M2+ but unused by these public operations. NestJS will implement controllers to match; Flutter generates packages/api_client when the backend ships. SoftAura visual tokens (#7A9E8E sage, warm ivory, charcoal) are fixed in the Flutter theme layer without stakeholder style approval.
adrs.consequences: Positive—parallel M2 catalog work without over-building; mock models mirror schemas; generated types reduce drift; no approval gates block coding. Negative—later milestones must extend the same OpenAPI carefully; M1 cannot exercise a live API until NestJS exists.

openapi_yaml:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SoftAura Skin Care API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    SoftAura Skin Care e-commerce API contract for the M1 Speed Demo and later milestones.
    M1 Flutter app uses local mock data only and does not call this API.
    This document covers must-have catalog stories (US-001 browse, US-002 detail):
    health probe plus two public catalog read operations. Cart is in-memory on
    the client in M1 (US-003 optional) and has no API operations here. Auth, payments,
    checkout, and orders are deferred.
  contact:
    name: SoftAura Engineering
servers:
  - url: http://10.0.2.2:3000/api/v1
    description: Android emulator → local staging
  - url: https://api.staging.softaura.example/api/v1
    description: Staging
  - url: https://api.softaura.example/api/v1
    description: Production
tags:
  - name: Health
    description: Service health checks
  - name: Catalog
    description: SoftAura skincare product browse and detail (public)
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags:
        - Health
      operationId: getHealth
      summary: Health check
      description: Returns 200 when the service and database are reachable.
      security: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthResponse'
        '503':
          description: Service unavailable (database unreachable)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /products:
    get:
      tags:
        - Catalog
      operationId: listProducts
      summary: List SoftAura skincare products
      description: |
        Paginated product listing with optional category filter and search.
        Supports US-001 browse requirements for 24 SKUs across Body Wash,
        Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care. Public endpoint; no authentication required.
        Prices are integer minor units with ISO 4217 currency USD.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Page'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PageSize'
        - name: q
          in: query
          description: Case-insensitive search against product name, brand, and description
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 100
            example: Olay
        - name: category
          in: query
          description: Filter by SoftAura skincare category
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/SkinCareCategorySlug'
        - name: minPriceCents
          in: query
          description: Minimum display price in USD cents (inclusive)
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            example: 999
        - name: maxPriceCents
          in: query
          description: Maximum display price in USD cents (inclusive)
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            example: 2999
        - name: sort
          in: query
          description: Sort order for results
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - priceAsc
              - priceDesc
              - nameAsc
              - newest
            default: newest
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated product list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductListResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid query parameters
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /products/{productId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - Catalog
      operationId: getProductById
      summary: Get SoftAura product detail
      description: |
        Returns full product detail including brand, category, description, and active variants
        with per-variant stock. Supports US-002. Public endpoint. Body-wash style flagship
        (Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style) must return price 1299 cents USD.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProductId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Product detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductDetail'
        '404':
          description: Product not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: |
        JWT access token (15-minute TTL). Declared for M2+ protected endpoints.
        Catalog and health operations in this document do not require a bearer token.
  parameters:
    Page:
      name: page
      in: query
      description: 1-based page number
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        default: 1
    PageSize:
      name: pageSize
      in: query
      description: Items per page
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 24
    ProductId:
      name: productId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Product UUID
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  schemas:
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - status
        - database
        - timestamp
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - ok
            - degraded
        database:
          type: string
          enum:
            - up
            - down
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - statusCode
        - error
        - message
      properties:
        statusCode:
          type: integer
          example: 400
        error:
          type: string
          example: Bad Request
        message:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: array
              items:
                type: string
          example: Invalid query parameter pageSize
    Money:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - amountCents
        - currency
      properties:
        amountCents:
          type: integer
          description: Amount in minor units (cents)
          minimum: 0
          example: 1299
        currency:
          type: string
          description: ISO 4217 currency code
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          example: USD
    SkinCareCategorySlug:
      type: string
      description: SoftAura M1 skincare category slug used for browse filters
      enum:
        - body-wash
        - cleansers
        - moisturizers
        - face-care
    Category:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - slug
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
          example: Body Wash
        slug:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/SkinCareCategorySlug'
    ProductSummary:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - brand
        - category
        - price
        - primaryImageUrl
        - inStock
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
          example: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash
        brand:
          type: string
          description: Curated third-party brand name
          example: Olay
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          allOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
          description: Display price (default or lowest active variant); 1299 cents USD for flagship body wash style
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Rounded product imagery URL or asset URI
        inStock:
          type: boolean
          description: True when at least one active variant has stockQuantity > 0
    ProductListResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - items
        - total
        - page
        - pageSize
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        total:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Total matching products (24 for full unfiltered M1 seed)
        page:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        pageSize:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    ProductVariant:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - sku
        - name
        - price
        - stockQuantity
        - isDefault
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        sku:
          type: string
          example: SA-OLAY-BW-SHEA-650
        name:
          type: string
          description: Variant label (e.g. size/volume)
          example: 650 mL
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        stockQuantity:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Available stock for this variant (static in M1 mock)
        imageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        isDefault:
          type: boolean
          description: Default variant used for list/detail price and availability
    ProductDetail:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - brand
        - description
        - category
        - price
        - primaryImageUrl
        - inStock
        - variants
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
          example: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash
        brand:
          type: string
          example: Olay
        description:
          type: string
          description: Longer listing copy for the SoftAura product detail screen
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          allOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
          description: Display price from default variant (1299 cents USD for body-wash style flagship)
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        inStock:
          type: boolean
        variants:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductVariant'
prisma_schema:
// SoftAura Skin Care — PostgreSQL 16 schema (Prisma)
// M1 mobile app does NOT connect to this database; seeded for M2+ backend.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum OrderStatus {
  pending_payment
  paid
  fulfilled
  delivered
  cancelled
  refunded
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  requires_payment_method
  requires_confirmation
  requires_action
  processing
  succeeded
  canceled
  failed
}

enum AddressLabel {
  home
  work
  other
}

model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email        String    @unique @db.VarChar(255)
  passwordHash String?   @map("password_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  displayName  String?   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  deletedAt    DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  refreshTokens RefreshToken[]
  addresses     Address[]
  cart          Cart?
  orders        Order[]

  @@map("users")
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  tokenHash String    @map("token_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  expiresAt DateTime  @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamptz
  revokedAt DateTime? @map("revoked_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

model Address {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId     String       @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  label      AddressLabel @default(home)
  fullName   String       @map("full_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  line1      String       @db.VarChar(200)
  line2      String?      @db.VarChar(200)
  city       String       @db.VarChar(100)
  region     String       @db.VarChar(100)
  postalCode String       @map("postal_code") @db.VarChar(20)
  country    String       @default("US") @db.VarChar(2)
  isDefault  Boolean      @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt  DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user   User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  orders Order[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("addresses")
}

model Category {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name      String   @db.VarChar(100)
  slug      String   @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0) @map("sort_order")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  products Product[]

  @@map("categories")
}

model Product {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  categoryId      String   @map("category_id") @db.Uuid
  name            String   @db.VarChar(200)
  slug            String   @unique @db.VarChar(200)
  brand           String   @db.VarChar(100)
  description     String   @db.Text
  primaryImageUrl String   @map("primary_image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  category Category         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  variants ProductVariant[]

  @@index([categoryId])
  @@index([brand])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("products")
}

model ProductVariant {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  productId        String   @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  sku              String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  name             String   @db.VarChar(120)
  priceCents       Int      @map("price_cents")
  currency         String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  stockQuantity    Int      @default(0) @map("stock_quantity")
  reservedQuantity Int      @default(0) @map("reserved_quantity")
  imageUrl         String?  @map("image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  isDefault        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  isActive         Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  product    Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  cartItems  CartItem[]
  orderItems OrderItem[]

  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_variants")
}

model Cart {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String   @unique @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user  User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

model CartItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  cartId         String   @map("cart_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId      String   @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  quantity       Int      @default(1)
  unitPriceCents Int      @map("unit_price_cents")
  currency       String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  productName    String   @map("product_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  variantName    String   @map("variant_name") @db.VarChar(120)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  cart    Cart           @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@unique([cartId, variantId])
  @@index([cartId])
  @@map("cart_items")
}

model Order {
  id                      String      @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId                  String      @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  status                  OrderStatus @default(pending_payment)
  currency                String      @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  subtotalCents           Int         @map("subtotal_cents")
  shippingCents           Int         @default(0) @map("shipping_cents")
  taxCents                Int         @default(0) @map("tax_cents")
  totalCents              Int         @map("total_cents")
  shippingAddressId       String?     @map("shipping_address_id") @db.Uuid
  shippingAddressSnapshot Json?       @map("shipping_address_snapshot")
  stripePaymentIntentId   String?     @unique @map("stripe_payment_intent_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  paidAt                  DateTime?   @map("paid_at") @db.Timestamptz
  fulfilledAt             DateTime?   @map("fulfilled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  deliveredAt             DateTime?   @map("delivered_at") @db.Timestamptz
  cancelledAt             DateTime?   @map("cancelled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt               DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt               DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user            User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  shippingAddress Address?    @relation(fields: [shippingAddressId], references: [id])
  items           OrderItem[]
  payment         Payment?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId        String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId      String?  @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  productName    String   @map("product_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  variantName    String   @map("variant_name") @db.VarChar(120)
  sku            String   @db.VarChar(64)
  quantity       Int
  unitPriceCents Int      @map("unit_price_cents")
  currency       String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  lineTotalCents Int      @map("line_total_cents")
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  order   Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model Payment {
  id                    String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId               String        @unique @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  stripePaymentIntentId String        @unique @map("stripe_payment_intent_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  status                PaymentStatus
  amountCents           Int           @map("amount_cents")
  currency              String        @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  stripeEventId         String?       @unique @map("stripe_event_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  createdAt             DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt             DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  order Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("payments")
}
